rev6.release_notes: Updates: when an AI app's connection to CAD CAM (or a copy left behind by a closed session) holds it, the update says so and Update Both closes those connections and installs. A CAD CAM window is never closed.

cadcam.release_notes:
Recognize Part: Ctrl-pick several features and make one toolpath on them all; holes of several sizes open one Drill / Tap / Thread Mill per size, in turn (OK opens the next, Esc stops).
Recognize Part: Delete a feature (or one hole of a pattern) and Restore it; Merge whole features into one named feature, Unmerge it; F2 renames. Saved with the part.
Recognize Part: PROGRAM IT button, and the Work Tree's FEATURES folder.
Milling: new Slot toolpath (ramps in, 1 or 2 passes, stepdown .05" / 1 mm), with a finish pass round the wall and Wear cutter comp. On the ribbon.
Setup window: an Advanced fold picks the turning centre line, the origin (Z0) and WCS X from the part or a sketch, for parts turned about a line other than their own axis (a side bore). Second sides follow their first side, and re-picking the line after making toolpaths works them out again on OK.
Setup window: right-click any row for Save Setting / Restore Setting, so every new setup starts with your value. Saved op settings now come back on every new op.
Sketch: smooth lines, circles and arcs at any zoom; a sketch on a face shows the part behind it as a quiet backdrop.
AI connection: the key lives in its own file, read first by every route.
CAD ribbon: Chamfer before Fillet.
